Disclaimer* Serco Group PLC 09 October 2026 09 October 2026 Legal Entity Identifier: 549300PT2CIHYN5GWJ21 Serco Group plc Transactions in own shares Serco Group plc (the " Company ") announces that, in accordance with the terms of its share buyback programme (the " Programme ") announced on 11 August 2026, it has purchased the following number of its ordinary shares of 2 pence each (" Ordinary Shares ") through RBC Europe Limited. Date of purchase: Number of Ordinary Shares purchased: Average price paid per Share (pence): Lowest price paid per Share (pence): Highest price paid per Share (pence): 05-Oct-2026 290,555 252.2229 250.8000 254.2000 06-Oct-2026 300,000 249.7081 247.2000 253.2000 07-Oct-2026 297,278 249.1652 247.4000 251.8000 08-Oct-2026 291,123 251.4389 245.2000 253.4000 09-Oct-2026 275,414 254.5203 253.2000 255.2000 Following the above transactions, the Company will have 961,731,653 Ordinary Shares in issue (excluding treasury shares). The total number of Ordinary Shares held in treasury is 41,014,361 . The total number of voting rights in the Company, excluding treasury shares as at 09 October 2026 is 961,731,653 . This figure may be used by shareholders (and others with notification obligations) as the denominator for the calculations by which they will determine if they are required to notify their interest in, or a change to their interest in, Company or its Group under the Financial Conduct Authority's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules. Since the announcement of the Programme on 11 August 2026, the Company has purchased a total of 12,563,896 Ordinary Shares, which are held in treasury.
